items.label: Customer's statement of the dispute
items.why_it_matters: Defines what is being claimed; without it nothing can be tested.

items.label: Ledger record of the disputed transaction
items.why_it_matters: The authoritative amount, time, parties and reference.

items.label: Authentication logs around the transfer
items.why_it_matters: Shows how the session was authenticated (failed attempts, OTP, device).

items.label: Device used for the transfer
items.why_it_matters: Links the transfer to a known or new device.

items.label: Customer evidence (receipt, screenshot, statement)
items.why_it_matters: Lets the customer's account be reconciled with the ledger.

items.label: National cyber-fraud complaint acknowledgement
items.why_it_matters: Needed to coordinate holds with other banks.

items.label: Beneficiary account details (KYC, opening date)
items.why_it_matters: Mule indicators depend on who controls the beneficiary account.

items.label: Trail from the receiving institution
items.why_it_matters: This bank cannot see beyond an external transfer.

checklist.note: Missing evidence lowers completeness only. It is not evidence for or against the claim.
